title: Emergency Liquidity Migration Across Chains
narrative: Aave Ethereum pool's LTV is being urgently reduced. Three agents must coordinate to migrate positions to Arbitrum before the change takes effect within 48 hours.

agents.mission: Preserve capital and maintain stable yield across chain migration
Detect and alert on protocol-level risk changes in real-time
Execute cross-chain transactions optimally with minimum slippage and gas

trigger_event.description: Aave governance initiates emergency vote: reduce ETH LTV from 80% to 70%. Effective in 48 hours.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Proposal 0xabc... submitted to Aave Governance contract at block 19850000

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect governance event via KG Governance:Aave node
Assess impact: 50 ETH borrowed * ETH_price * (0.80-0.70) = liquidation risk increases by 12.5%
Pull alert from shared KG → query Aave position status
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Decision: migrate 400,000 USDC supply + repay 50 ETH loan → move to Aave Arbitrum

expected_coordination_flow.action: Delegate execution plan to execution_agent via KG:Task node
Execute migration: repay ETH loan on Aave Ethereum (use 400000 USDC to swap → ETH → repay)
Bridge remaining USDC (~390000 after swap/gas) via Hop to Arbitrum
Supply USDC to Aave Arbitrum → confirm completion
Verify new positions on Arbitrum are healthy → check Aave Arbitrum health factor

coordination_efficiency.description: Total steps taken vs. expected optimal (8 steps)

consensus_latency.description: Time from first agent detection to all agents agreeing on action plan

system_resilience.description: What happens when execution_agent goes offline at step 5

scale.5: Automatic task reassignment to backup agent within 5 minutes
